in_marathi.name: Premchand
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Loved by God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Premchand हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name of reverence and devotion, derived from the Sanskrit words 'prem' meaning love and 'chand' meaning God. It is believed that the name Premchand was given to those who were loved by God.
